title: Special Executive Masters Programme in Occupational Health and Safety Management
description: This course introduces the principles and practices of occupational health and safety management to promote safe, healthy, and compliant working environments.
longDescription: Course Overview This programme develops advanced knowledge and professional competencies in occupational health and safety management across diverse organisational settings. It explores workplace hazard identification, risk assessment, accident prevention, and the implementation of effective safety management systems. Learners examine occupational health and safety legislation, regulatory compliance, emergency preparedness, and strategies for promoting employee wellbeing. The programme prepares professionals to lead safety initiatives, manage occupational risks, and foster a proactive culture of health and safety within organisations.
courseDetails: Analyse the principles, theories, and strategic importance of occupational health and safety management in organisational contexts. Evaluate workplace hazards and apply advanced risk assessment techniques to develop effective prevention and control strategies. Interpret relevant occupational health and safety legislation, regulations, standards, and organisational compliance requirements. Develop and implement occupational health and safety policies, procedures, and management systems aligned with organisational objectives. Assess accident investigation methods, emergency response procedures, and incident prevention strategies to improve workplace safety performance. Evaluate health and safety performance indicators and recommend continuous improvement strategies that promote employee wellbeing and a positive safety culture. Mode of Study Using Web-based technology, this program provides self-paced, individualized instruction that can be taken anywhere and anytime an individual has access to a computer and the Internet. This programme is suitable for successful professionals or specialists in the private, public, or voluntary sectors who have new management responsibilities and need to expand their health management knowledge quickly. This Programme serves as a refresher course for those who had their Masters's a long time ago and need quick reminders and professional/ academic updates, while it also serves as a primer for those very experienced Professionals who never made time out for their masters yet they require the academic and practical relevance of this master’s experience. It is a short executive training that runs online for three months. Upon successfully completing the Programme, candidates will be awarded a Continuing Professional Development (CPD) certificate in the specific Programme they have completed. What is a CPD Course? Continuing Professional Development (CPD) is how professionals maintain and enhance their knowledge and skills. The world is constantly moving at a very fast pace so undertaking CPD is essential to support a professional in his/her current role as well as helping them with career progression. CPD is all about upgrading knowledge, skills, and capabilities to remain effective and compliant. A CPD course is an investment that you make in yourself. It’s a way of planning your development that links learning directly to practice. CPD can help you keep your skills and knowledge up to date and prepare you for greater responsibilities. It can boost your confidence, strengthen your professional credibility, and help you become more creative in tackling new challenges.
